content.summary: The integrated exposition coherently separates the extremal theorem, imported foundations, local proof obligations and assurance limits. The tree-integrity qualification is precise and appropriately narrows the earlier absence claim. No new writing revision is required; this remains an intermediate review rather than final proof acceptance.

findings.statement: Theorem1's ordinary imported-theorem formulation and Sections2/7's assurance limitations remain consistent. The new repository-tree discrepancy is neither concealed nor presented as a mathematical counterexample.
findings.disposition: Retain these boundaries. This integrated reading does not independently certify every coefficient, classification or external computation.

revisions.action: Re-read definitions throughout the integrated proof.
revisions.result: Complete links, actual anchors, residual traces and component-support conventions remain defined; closure is preserved.

revisions.action: Rechecked the obligation map and superseding source pointers.
revisions.result: The earlier map repair remains intact and now includes the tree-integrity addendum.

revisions.action: Re-read Theorem2's root-selection paragraph and table.
revisions.result: Maximum-degree selection still justifies the degree6-first split and conditional global cap5; AW-ROOT-03 remains resolved.

checks.scope: Whole-proof progression and final theorem scope
checks.method: Read the frozen manuscript across Sections1-8 and compared the successive degree transitions with GLOBAL67-ordinary-theorem.md, Mathematical proof by maximum degree.
checks.observation: The proof fixes a 68-member family, derives cap20 and mu41, excludes degrees20 through16, and closes cap15 through an actual degree15 link and the three rho domains. Guarded cap18 imports enter after degree19. The conclusion preserves arbitrary support and the maximum-size convention. The abstract, statement and conclusion consistently identify ordinary computer-assisted assurance rather than whole-theorem Lean verification.

checks.scope: Integrated obligation map for Theorem2 and cap15
checks.method: Compared the final table with LOW15-complete-argument.md, its upstream and rho-domain sections, and R15-rho6-completed-evidence.md.
checks.observation: The map separates arbitrary-support normalization, derived support, three finite trees, exact-rho7 classification, both deletion contradictions and graph/cover closure. The completed-evidence note explicitly supersedes earlier pending degree2 reconstruction status. The main text retains the maximum-degree root repair and distinguishes the universal fifteen-triple lemma from its later complete-link application. No case is omitted by the exposition-level organization inspected here.

checks.scope: New tree-integrity wording and assurance consistency
checks.method: Compared Section2 with EXTERNAL-H27-TREE-INTEGRITY-ADDENDUM-20261024.md and the preserved reconstruction results; independently hashed the saved 266-byte root-tree payload with Git's object header.
checks.observation: The payload gives 0a3e3838650fc981133940e798c9d220140e785e, differing from reported d4d5723267c662291efdadfa6e7061d919e76fa9. The manuscript therefore limits provenance-file absence to the returned listing and preserves the separately matching blob distinction. The addendum discloses the unavailable transient response, establishes no cause, and retains H27 as an unreconstructed external theorem dependency. I did not independently rebuild all subordinate trees.
